# read_B: pp. 93–95 (leaves n94–n96), plus the seam line p. 92.5, read from the images

## Lines and layout

- **p. 93 (n94)** has five lines. It is a leaf front and opens with the horizontal-swirl ornament, a wide blank, then `༔`. I write this `༄༅༔ ༔`, following the 009 editor's decision.
  - **93.1 is a short line.** It ends at x≈1700 with `…མེད་པར་ཐིམ་` (with a tsheg). An empty framed box fills the rest of the line, as on 89.1.
- **p. 94 (n95)** has five lines. It is a leaf back and has no ornament.
- **p. 95 (n96)** has five lines. It is a leaf front and opens `༄༅༔ ༔`.
- **In all:** 15 print lines.

**Seam with Reader A (p. 92.5, n93 line 5, read for the log only).**
- p. 92.5 reads `[ཁྱོ]ད་རང་གི་ཡི་དམ་གྱི་ལྷ་ཡིན་པས་མ་སྐྲག་ཅིག༔ དོན་ལ་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་རྣམ་པར་སྣང་མཛད་ཡབ་ཡུམ་དངོས་ཡིན་པས་མ་འཇིགས་`.
  - The first stack is partly blotted; it is the end of `ཁྱོད`.
  - The line ends at x≈1790 with a tsheg followed by filler dots.
- p. 93.1 opens `[ornament]༔ ༔ཤིག༔`, so the seam reads `…ཡིན་པས་མ་འཇིགས་ཤིག༔`. The seam is clean and needs no fix.
- The print has `མ་འཇིགས་ཤིག` here, where the other recension has `མ་སྐྲག་ཅིག`.

## Method

- **Line bands** came from row profiles over the text columns.
  - Headline rows: n94 ≈ 110/165/220/275/330; n95 ≈ 140/195/250/305/360; n96 ≈ 125/180/245/300/355.
  - Slope is about −0.0135 px/px on n96 and +0.0125 px/px on n97. Crops were shifted to follow it.
- **Crops.** Each line was cropped in four or five overlapping segments at ×3–×4 (LANCZOS). Doubtful stacks were cropped at ×6–×12.
- **Pixel dumps** (threshold 128) were used for the line-end tshegs and for the hard stretch on 95.3 (n96 x 940–1330).
- **Tshegs inside lines** are often fused to the head bars. Where the image cannot decide, I followed normal word division (and the other recension), as earlier readers did.
- **Filler dots** inside lines (94.2 and 95.5 after `སྟོབ`) and at line ends are left out. Where filler follows a syllable, the first dot is taken as its tsheg.

## [?] (2), no […] gaps

| place | as written | candidates / why |
|---|---|---|
| 94.1 | `མཐོང་ཤོལ[?]༔` | The letter after `མཐོང་` carries a naro and has a left hook. It reads as ཤ (other recension `ཐོང་གཤོལ`); ཞ (`ཞོལ`) is the alternative. No ག prefix is printed, and the print has a མ prefix on `མཐོང`. |
| 95.3 | `ནག་རབ[?]་འབར་བ༔` | After `ནག` come eight stems where `ནག་འབར་བ` needs only five: ར, a box, a box, ར, བ. I read the boxes as བ + འ, giving `རབ་འབར་བ` ("blazing fiercely"). The other recension has `ནག་འབར་བ`. The two boxes cannot be told apart for certain (བ vs འ). |

**Doubtful but resolved (no [?]):**
- 93.4 and 95.3 `བགྲད`: the top letter of the stack has the inner diagonal of ག, not ས.
- 95.3 `སེར`: the e-vowel (a diagonal stroke ending on the head bar at x≈1095) and the ར (x≈1105–1124) are both in the pixel dump.
- 95.3 `གཡོན་དམར་དབུས`: there is no `བ༔` after `དམར`. The ད of `དབུས` follows ར directly.
- 95.1 `ཆེའི`: over the འ there are two small loops (×12). Read as the gi-gu of `འི`, possibly doubled by a cutting flaw.

## Proposed fixes

```
# fix: ཞག་དགུ་པལ་ཁྲག => ཞག་དགུ་པ་ལ་ཁྲག
# fix: ཡབཀྱི་སྐུ་ལ => ཡབ་ཀྱི་སྐུ་ལ
# fix: འཆར་དུ་འྔོ༔ => འཆར་དུ་འོང་ངོ༔
```

- **94.2 `འྔོ`** is a mid-line contraction: འ with naro and a subjoined ང, for `འོང་ངོ` (×12). The other recension has `འཆར་དུ་འོང་ངོ་༔` here. It could also be read as plain `འོང`. `འོང་ངོ` is preferred because a ༔ follows and this is how sentences end elsewhere on these pages (94.4 `འོང་ངོ༔`).
- There are no `པའཾ`, `ལཾ`, `ནམཁའ` or subscript-ས forms on these pages.

## Suspected misprints

None that is certain. The following are **kept, note only**:
- **`དངངས` (93.2, 94.3, 94.5)** for the other recension's `སྔངས` ("terror"). The print is consistent, and `དངངས་སྐྲག` is a standard spelling, so this is not a misprint.
- **`ཁཊྭཾ་ག` (95.4)** for `ཁ་ཊྭཾ་ག/ཀ`: a print spelling of khaṭvāṅga.
- **`མཐོང་ཤོལ[?]` (94.1)** for `ཐོང་གཤོལ` (a plough-shaped implement). A prefix is added and one is dropped. The sense is clear, so the print is followed.
- **`ཏྲི་ཤུལ` (95.4)**, where the other recension has `དྲི་ཤུལ`. Both are spellings of the same implement name.

## Where the print differs from the other recension (print followed)

**Sense changes, or words added or left out:**
- **92.5/93.1** `…ཡིན་པས་མ་འཇིགས་ཤིག༔` ("do not fear"); the other recension has `མ་སྐྲག་ཅིག༔` ("do not be afraid"). The sense is close.
- **93.1** `དུས་མཉམ་མོ༔` ("are simultaneous"); the other recension has `དུས་མཉམ་དུ་འོང་ངོ༔`. The sense is the same. The print also adds ༔ after `ཞེས་བསྒྲགས་པས`.
- **93.2** `ཡང་དེ་ལ་དངངས་སྐྲག་སྐྱེས་ནས་བྲོས་པས་ངོ་མ་འཕྲོད་ན༔ ཞག་དགུ་པ་ལ་`; the other recension has `…སྐྱེས་ཤིང་བྲོས་ནས་…ན༔ ཡང་ཞག་དགུ་པ་ལ༔`. The sense is the same.
- **93.3** `བསུ་བ་ལ་འོང་བས༔ ཡང་ངོ་སྤྲད་པ་ནི༔`; the other recension has `ཡོང་བས་ངོ་སྤྲད་པ་ནི༔`. The sense is the same.
- **93.3→93.4: the print LEAVES OUT `མ་ཡེངས་པར་ཉོན་ཅིག༔ ཞག་དགུ་བ་ལ`.**
  - The print reads `ཀྱེ་རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ༔ | ཁྲག་འཐུང་རྡོ་རྗེ་རིགས་ཀྱི་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་…`. This is checked at ×8 on both sides of the line break.
  - The address "listen without distraction; on the ninth day…" is missing. The parallel passages for days 10 (95.1–2) and 11 do have it, so this is probably an omission by the cutter. It is kept, note only, because nothing in the image supports adding words.
- **93.4** `རྡོ་རྗེ་རིགས་ཀྱི་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས` (genitive: "the Bhagavān of the vajra family"); the other recension has `ཀྱིས༔` (agentive). There is a small change in construction.
- **93.5 and 95.3** `ཞལ་གཡས་དཀར་བ` ("the right face is white"); the other recension has `གཡས་དཀར་བ`. The print adds ཞལ.
- **94.1** `བར་མ་ན` (and again at 95.4); the other recension has `བར་བ་ན`. The sense is the same.
- **94.2** `ཀླད་པའི་ཤར་ནས་ཐོན་ནས` ("from the east of the brain"); the other recension has `ཀླད་པའི་ནང་གི་ཤར་ནས` ("from the east within the brain").
- **94.3: the print LEAVES OUT a whole passage.** The other recension has `རང་གི་རིག་པའི་སྐུ་རུ་ངོ་ཤེས་པར་གྱིས་ཤིག༔ ཁྱོད་རང་གི་ཡི་དམ་གྱི་ལྷ་ཡིན་པས་མ་སྐྲག་ཅིག༔` ("recognise it as the form of your own awareness; it is your yidam, do not fear"). The print goes straight from `མ་དངངས་ཤིག༔` to `དོན་ལ་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་རྡོ་རྗེ་སེམས་དཔའ…`.
- **94.3** `…དངོས་ཡིན་པས་མ་སྐྲག་ཅིག༔ མོས་པ་གྱིས་ཤིག༔` ("…so do not fear; have devotion"); the other recension has `…ཡིན་པས་མོས་གུས་གྱིས་ཤིག༔`. The print adds `མ་སྐྲག་ཅིག` and has `མོས་པ` for `མོས་གུས`.
- **94.4** `ཐིམ་ནས་སངས་རྒྱས་པར་འགྱུར་རོ༔`; the other recension has `ཐིམ་ནས་ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུར་སངས་རྒྱས`. **The print leaves out "in the sambhogakāya".** The parallel for day 8 (93.2) does have `ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུར`.
- **94.5** `ཡང་ཞག་བཅུ་པ་ལ` adds ཡང.
- **95.1** `ཁྲག་འཐུང་རིན་པོ་ཆེའི་རིགས་ཀྱིས་བསུ་བ་ལ་འོང་བས`; the other recension has `རིན་ཆེན་རིགས་ཀྱིས…འོང་པས`. The sense is the same.
- **95.2** `རིན་པོ་ཆེའི་རིགས་རཏྣ་ཧེ་རུ་ཀ་ཞེས་བྱ་བ༔`; the other recension has `རིན་ཆེན་རིགས་ཀྱི༔ བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་རཏྣ་ཧེ་རུ་ཀ`. **The print leaves out `ཀྱི༔ བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས`.**
- **95.3** `གཡོན་དམར་དབུས་སེར་ནག་རབ[?]་འབར་བ༔`; the other recension has `གཡོན་དམར་བ༔ དབུས་སེར་ནག་འབར་བ༔`. The print adds `རབ` ("intensely blazing") and has no `བ༔` after དམར.
- **95.5** `ཀླད་པའི་ལྷོ་ནས་ཐོན་ནས་རང་ལ་`; the other recension has `ཀླད་པའི་ནང་གི་ལྷོ་ནས་ཐོན་རང་ལ`. The print leaves out `ནང་གི` and adds `ནས`.
